Sword & Shield series · LOR

Lost Origin

Released September 9, 2022 · 217 cards

StandardExpanded

Lost Origin is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Sword & Shield series, released in English on September 9, 2022. Its main set has 196 cards, plus 21 secret rares numbered beyond the set (217 in total). It includes 177 Pokémon, 39 Trainer and 1 Energy cards, and is legal in the Standard and Expanded formats.

Illustrators

82 illustrators worked on Lost Origin. Most cards: 5ban Graphics (16), N-DESIGN Inc. (9), Kouki Saitou (8), AKIRA EGAWA (5), Miki Tanaka (5), Oswaldo KATO (5), PLANETA Mochizuki (5), Scav (5).
